name: host-run-codex-turn-failed-reason
title: host_run codex final records turn.failed as a specific honest unavailableReason
description: When a `lattice host_run --host codex` run fails, the usage-ledger final currently records only the generic unavailableReason `no_turn_completed_usage_event`, because the streaming usage-line retainer keeps only `turn.completed` lines. The terminal failure event codex actually emitted (e.g. `{"type":"turn.failed","error":{"message":"...status 400... The 'gpt-5.6-sol' model requires a newer version of Codex..."}}`) is discarded, so the real cause must be recovered from external Codex Desktop rollouts — and `--ephemeral` runs leave no codex session file at all. Extend the codex usage-line retainer/scanner path so `turn.failed` (and terminal `error`) events are also retained (bounded, last-one-wins, same 1MiB cap discipline) and recorded as a more specific honest unavailableReason `turn_failed(<short digest of error.message>)`, falling back to `no_turn_completed_usage_event` when neither event is present. Honest-unavailable semantics are preserved: usage is never fabricated, and a genuine `turn.completed` usage still records provider-reported exactly as today.
